title: Suspect who came at Calgary police officer with a screwdriver shot four times
article: CALGARY - Investigators say a suspect armed with a screwdriver who came at a Calgary police officer was shot four times and died in hospital.
The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team is in the early stages of its investigation into the shooting, which happened early Thursday morning after police tried to stop two stolen trucks.

Assistant director Roy Fitzpatrick says a screwdriver was recovered from the backyard of the home where the shooting took place and investigators are looking for any witnesses who saw or heard anything.
The dead man has been identified as Jonathan Rawlings.
The 36-year-old had been arrested on a Canada-wide warrant for 10 drug and weapons charges last September.
Fitzpatrick says the investigation will look at the entire police operation, including the shooting, the stopping of the two stolen trucks and the arrest and injury of another man.
Calgary's police chief says he backs the actions of his officer, who was 10-year veteran and a member of the tactical team.
